" The crack of a bat accompanied by a roar from the crowd can capture a baseball fan’s attention, even if they miss seeing the home run. Humans may be visual creatures, but we also perceive the world around us by listening to it. To improve artificial perception, MIT Professor Paris Smaragdis SM ’97, PhD ’01 seeks to make machines that can hear and understand sound even better than humans.

sec.title: Adobe Fixes 8 Critical Campaign Classic Flaws Allowing Code Execution and Security Bypass
sec.brief: Adobe has released patches to address multiple critical security flaws in Campaign Classic that, if successfully exploited, could result in arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation. 9) - A code injection vulnerability that could lead to arbitrary code execution.
